I've attached a corrected invite that is explicitly set to Singapore Time and created fresh event links so it shows correctly in SGT. I also attached the slide deck we planned to walk through so you have the high-level context ahead of the rebook.

Proposed rebook windows (all in SGT) — please pick any that work and I'll lock it in:
- Mon Jun 22, 09:00–09:45 SGT
- Tue Jun 23, 10:30–11:15 SGT
- Wed Jun 24, 11:00–11:45 SGT

If none of those work, tell me 2x 30–45m windows that do and I'll prioritize. We're happy to include your partnerships team — I've cc'd them.

Attachments: corrected-invite.ics (text/calendar), demo-recap-slides.pdf (application/pdf), proposed-times-apac.png (image/png)

Again, apologies for the mix-up. We'll take care of rescheduling and make it an efficient 30–45 minute session that focuses on your deployment/readiness questions.
